interface.longDescription: Bring your customer research and Buyer Persona directly into your ChatGPT conversations and agent workflows. Test pricing, messaging and product ideas before you commit. Explore assumptions with AI-simulated interviews, let IVA, our AI interviewer, talk to real customers, or import conversations you already have. Use that understanding for product and go-to-market decisions, and generate positioning, landing pages and sales pitch decks. Research insights link to source interviews, with real and simulated sources clearly distinguished.
defaultPrompt: Ask my Buyer Persona to review my landing page.
Our new price is $49 a month. How would my Buyer Persona react?
Create a Buyer Persona for my business using AI-simulated interviews.
